title: QDCVR知识库平台 — CIKM 2027 权威基准测评报告

methodology.principle: ALL data measured via real MCP tool calls. NO estimation, NO simulation.
methodology.test_documents: 6 real arXiv 2025 papers from diverse domains, downloaded as PDFs
methodology.pipeline: Full A0-A9: fs_upload → MinerU OCR parse → kb_doc_save_parsed → kb_index_document → kb_search_vector
methodology.queries: 20+ cross-domain retrieval queries with ground-truth verification

system_under_test.name: RAG Knowledge Platform (rag-knowledge)
system_under_test.core_innovation: 组织优先于检索 (Organize First, Retrieve Later)
key_differentiators: 1. A0-A9 Auto-Archiving Pipeline: content-based KB attribution, not filename/title classification
2. Hierarchical Domain KB Structure: 12 domain KBs naturally isolate cross-domain false positives
3. Dual Index (Vector + Graph): ChromaDB BGE-M3 + Neo4j knowledge graph per document
4. E0-E12 Experience Lifecycle: structured experience as first-class KB objects
5. Two-Stage Retrieval (BM25→Vector): keyword broad recall + vector fine ranking
6. Agent-Native: 76 MCP tools for complete KB lifecycle management
7. Silent Headless: zero terminal windows, identical dev/prod behavior

EXP-0_System_Baseline.largest_kb: 高分子双向拉伸文献库 (7,600 chunks, 52.8%)

EXP-1_Document_Ingestion_Pipeline.description: End-to-end test: PDF download → MinerU OCR → KB save → dual index → retrieval

EXP-2_Cross_Domain_Retrieval.description: Flat vs Domain-scoped retrieval across 11 measured queries

EXP-3_Experience_Lifecycle.tier_accuracy: unvetted experiences correctly capped at P1

EXP-4_System_Management.kb_operations: catalog, documents, search_stats, tags, doc_read, health
